brief_rationale: The doctor completed all nine responsibility-chain items with appropriate safety screening, medication cautions, privacy handling, and clear follow-up planning. Multiple high-order capabilities were demonstrated: stigma-reducing communication about emotional screening, discovery of hidden decision variables through targeted questioning, privacy-friendly documentation advice, and responsibility-chain repair. Closure is valid with confirmed family teach-back. Grade 5 reflects complete RC coverage plus four completed high-order points with meaningful trajectory impact.

citations.explanation: Doctor confirms continued safe home plan with clear boundaries and medication safety
citations.quote: 药盒继续按您计划让原药房逐项核对，未确认前不要凭印象补服、停药或加止痛药

citations.quote: 这几天在家就继续按这个范围，只必要短距离、有人贴身护着、不自行改药，等门诊看，可以吗？

closure_assessment.explanation: Valid closure with explicit home safety plan, follow-up appointment confirmed, medication safety boundaries stated, and family demonstrating teach-back of key points. All blocking residual risks addressed; allowed uncertainties properly acknowledged.
closure_assessment.label: valid_closure
